name: [EASTER EVENT🥚] Trenches Tower Defence
desc: Trenches Tower Defence (TTD) Is a tower defence game based off WW1, our small development team are trying to bring consistent updates. Please keep in mind there are only two people actually working on this game so please be gentle! If you are interested in this project, feel free to join our communications server below, we post sneak peeks of new content and a text channel to talk to likeminded people.
